crew.overview: A first-time captain leads a convoy of allied ships carrying thousands of soldiers across the treacherous waters of the "Black Pit" to the front lines of WWII. With no air cover protection for 5 days, the captain and his convoy must battle the surrounding enemy Nazi U-boats in order to give the allies a chance to win the war.

details.biography: Adam Horwitz was born in Dayton, Ohio where he lived until his passion for performing drew him to Orlando, FL at the age of 21. There he worked in live shows for Disney, Universal Studios and Busch Gardens, and would eventually lead to him traveling the world as a stunt performer and actor working/living in Japan, Hong Kong, and Singapore for 5 years. Upon returning back to Florida, he realized that Film and Television was where he belonged. This took him to New Orleans, LA where he was lucky enough to continue to pursue and be successful in the career he loves. The rest is history. Adam has a very diverse look, and has played multiple ethnicities including, but not limited to: Arabic, Israeli, Latin, Greek, Chechnyan, Russian and American Indian. His most recent roles include doubling Jemaine Clement on Harold and the Purple Crayon, Andy Garcia on Memoirs of an International Assassin, Jason Antoon in Claws, Waleed Zuaiter on Billionaire Boys Club, and can be seen alongside Kurt Russell in Deepwater Horizon.
